about: A field for a date a person types or picks from a calendar. The trigger opens a panel of views: the days of a month, the months of a year and the years of a decade. The arrow keys move through a view's grid, Enter and Space pick, and hidden inputs submit the dates in ISO 8601 with a form.

availability.label: Availability
availability.pick: Pick an arrival and a departure. Struck-out days are booked.

localized.about: With locale de-DE the weekdays read Mo to So, and startOfWeek 1 starts the weeks on Monday. showWeekNumbers adds each week's number before it, which a screen reader reads as the row's header.
localized.title: Locale and week numbers

monthly.about: With minView and defaultView month the calendar picks a month, and the year view above it moves through the years. format writes the month's name, which ValueText shows.
monthly.title: A month

months.about: numOfMonths 2 shows two months, a second DayTable at offset 1. isDateUnavailable strikes out booked days, and a range cannot start or end on one. On a narrow page the months stack.
months.title: Two months, inline

multiple.about: With selectionMode multiple each press adds or removes a day, and maxSelectedDates stops at five. closeOnSelect false keeps the panel open, and ValueText lists the days.
multiple.title: Several days

palette.about: The palette of the selected days and a range's middle, one of the four hues that are not statuses.
palette.title: Palettes

ranged.about: With selectionMode range two inputs edit the start and the end, and a form receives period[0] and period[1]. Each preset sets a range relative to today.
ranged.title: A range with presets

selects.about: MonthSelect and YearSelect jump to a month and a year, for a date far from today. min and max bound the years the select lists.
selects.title: Month and year selects

size.about: The sizes a field passes down. The input and its triggers are controls of the same size as a text field, and the panel's cells grow with the size: 32, 36 and 40px.
size.title: Sizes

stated.about: A disabled picker dims and takes no focus. A read-only picker shows its date, opens no panel and hides its clear trigger. An invalid picker takes the error edge on its input.
stated.title: Disabled, read-only and invalid

status.about: The status sets the edge and the focus ring of the input from its palette, the same as a text field's.
status.title: Statuses

title: Date picker

validated.about: Inside a field the picker takes the field's label, texts and required and invalid states. min stops the days before today, isDateUnavailable the weekends, and a form receives the date in ISO 8601.
validated.title: In a validated field

variant.about: The three field looks of the theme on the input, the same as a text field's and a combobox's.
variant.title: Looks
